notes: Full-bleed fix, corrected. In 0.7.10 the wallpaper layer was extended under the status and navigation bars, but the container was clipping every child to its inset padding — the extension was silently erased and the bars remained. The container no longer clips to its padding, and the wallpaper's margins are now driven by the phone's real window insets rather than framework dimensions, so Kinto's wallpaper framing matches One UI's exactly: the picture runs under the status icons and down to the gesture bar. The Lens keeps sampling the same framing, so its socket and refraction stay registered with the background.
